title: Kit post hooks see the person's answers
summary: The ia plugin's PostToolUse hook now also runs for AskUserQuestion, so a kit's post handler that declares AskUserQuestion receives the question and its answers. ia-governance uses this to witness a plan approval or a change acceptance the person gives through a question; before, those answers never reached it, and a ledger whose only cure was the person's acceptance could not be sealed. AskUserQuestion reaches post handlers only: no kit can block or rewrite a question. This widens the qualified hook set for review (decision public-kit-handlers).
